patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I have a headache. WebMD said brain tumor. My sister said it's because I doom-scroll until 3am every night. I need a licensed professional to tell me which one of them is right.
presentation.triageNote: 39-year-old female, mild bilateral headache for a few days, no red-flag features, very worried after reading online.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: Discharge is appropriate because the presentation is mild and stable, with no expected emergency treatment-area resource after a reassuring assessment.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This is a mild, gradual headache lasting several days without a presented neurologic or systemic warning feature.
clinical.acuityReason: The patient has normal vital signs, mild pain, and no thunderclap onset, focal deficit, fever, trauma, or other disclosed red flag.
teachingPoints: Headache evaluation begins by looking for sudden onset, neurologic deficit, infection, trauma, pregnancy-related risk, and other warning features.
Imaging is not automatically required for a mild uncomplicated headache with a reassuring examination.

possibleDiagnoses: Headache related to sleep disruption or dehydration
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: A reassuring assessment could be followed by symptom advice, sleep and hydration guidance, explicit return precautions, and outpatient follow-up.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: 39-year-old woman in athleisure, phone in hand
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting relaxed, holding her phone up mid-scroll
aiImageGeneration.expression: anxious but healthy-looking, rubbing one temple
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a Black 39-year-old woman in athleisure with a phone in hand, on the same blue clinic chair. Pose: sitting relaxed, holding her phone up mid-scroll, rubbing one temple. Expression: anxious but clearly healthy-looking — NOT in pain. Clearly visible: well-appearing with good color, one hand at her temple. Overall completely well. No text, no logos.
